title: Gradients of Curves & Areas Under Graphs

problems_fixed.what: Within-tier duplicate answer: gradient came out 2, identical to bronze[0]. Re-posed the tangent points so the gradient is 5, keeping it a clean non-calculator integer and distinct in the tier.

opener_concept: A car at a steady 20 m/s for 3 s: distance = speed x time = 60, and that 60 is exactly the AREA of the 3-by-20 rectangle under the speed-time graph. Names area-under-graph = distance, and gradient-of-graph = speed, before any formal method.
